mods.name: Multiplayer
mods.author: JERICHO
mods.description: Online and LAN multiplayer for up to 16 players: discovery-server browser plus LAN discovery, dedicated server support, owner-authoritative car sync (each machine drives its own car and broadcasts its state; peers adopt it verbatim), a player-chosen on-foot character from the JMPPED archive (Tanner, Jericho and custom entries) synced through the host, in-match chat, a host-maintained roster, and a generic JERICHO addon net bridge. Minor version tracks MP_PROTO_VERSION (19).

mods.name: Car Hacks
mods.author: JERICHO
mods.description: Vehicle-availability and cross-city vehicle hacks for Driver 2: unlock the extra vehicles in the frontend car list, and import vehicles that belong to another city's data. Standalone (lifted out of Caine's Crossfire) so it can be enabled next to the multiplayer module.

mods.name: CRUMPLE
mods.author: Nattdy + DeepSeek
mods.description: Impact-driven vertex deformation + wheel damage. The flagship JERICHO package: dents, crumples, bent wheels, surface-roughness amplification, and the Crumple Debug pause submenu.

mods.name: BAKE Toolkit
mods.author: Jaret Ludvik
mods.description: Driver 1 (1999) traffic car shapes as a synthetic car-data source: bakes the seven retail Driver 1 cities plus the Euro-43 beta into carhacks, from your own Driver 1 data. See docs/DRIVER1.md.

mods.name: FULL TWIST
mods.author: JERICHO
mods.description: Free-physics tumbles: cars keep their spin after a hit, scenery torque uses the convex hull contact, walls bounce, and car-car recoil is tamed.

mods.name: Yaris Bounce
mods.author: Nattdy
mods.description: The squishy-Yaris meme effect: squash & stretch the car body's vertex copy as it drives (RSIN phase + quartic ease), drawn without touching physics or collision.

mods.name: Hallgarth's Cars
mods.author: Hallgarth, Jaret Ludvik
mods.description: Hallgarth's Pontiac Firebird as a BAKE car bank (HALLCHCG, Chicago model 1 slot): clean, damaged and low LODs with its own wheels and sounds. Data only: register banks/hallchcg/cities.ini and import it with carhacks.

mods.name: Ant Farm Screensaver
mods.author: REDRIVER2 community
mods.description: Passive city observer / idle screensaver: tours the map with 17 cinematic camera angles while the city keeps living; stands down during multiplayer. Compiled-in module (source package; already built into the JERICHO executable).
